## 维护者速读
- 是什么：删掉控制台和 Studio 里 build 专用的对话前端（方案卡、变更卡、诊断抽屉、草稿条、表格导入条、Studio 副驾驶等），问答聊天和 Studio 照常；没有拆分组件。
- 为什么要你：删了 3.2 万行，超过 3000 行的人工合并线；没有碰受治理文件，也不涉及元数据协议。
- 要你做什么：用批准账号批准本 PR（head `2f5c6af662e4`）；批准后席位翻 ready、排队合并。
- 出问题会怎样：最坏是问答聊天里某个按钮或文案缺失；回滚这一个合并即可。

Seat opinion: approve and land.

## 席位核对

Seat L1 verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `2f5c6af662e4678d31f1acb7f3f1f0e36dd587a5` · 2026-11-27T00:43Z · `Fixes #37682`.

- **Round 1 REWORK (handed to the card thread):** `l1-face` flagged `changeset` — `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` touched (comment / test edits) with no entry. Fixed by one commit adding the three as `patch` with a no-behaviour sentence; `l1-face` now CLEAN (13 items).
- **Scope:** maintainer order 「先删 build 的部分 可以先处理」, 「拆分组件 之后的部分先不派发」 — build parts deleted, no file split, no approval/question-card redesign. File surface as amended on the card (comment 7203297023): out-of-surface edits are cleanup after removed code (tests importing deleted symbols, two comment-only edits, the `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` importer entry, dead cache arms), plus a stale DEBT entry in `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` (mechanical, same gate family). Premise correction accepted: `publishHealth.ts` stays (`preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` imports it).
- **Contract surface:** the removed exports (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` root and `/core`, one `ConversationsSidebar` prop, 280 `@object-ui/i18n` keys) are listed by package in the body; both changesets mark the removal breaking with the ADR-0087 markers (`runtime-export-retired`, `no-migration-prescription`; `check-adr-0087-registration` passes). These are UI component exports, not the metadata protocol: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no `(narrowing)` arm, no `packages/spec` or governed path ⇒ no contract-tier L2 owed. This corrects the claim's line, which said one was owed.
- **Acceptance notes (left for a later card, not filed now per the maintainer's "later parts not dispatched"):** dormant Builder-handoff plumbing (`chatDockTarget` / `chatDockControl` / `useConsoleChatDock` / `AiAddressRedirect`), the plan-approval bus and its launcher marker, `surfaceAgent.ts` maker helpers, `ChatDockConversationActions.showDebug` now always false.
- **Gates at this head:** 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed (Test UI 16/16 shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, TypeScript Type Check, Lint & Repo Gates, Check Changeset). Local: `console:build` 81/81, tsc src + tests, lint 0 errors, Studio and i18n suites 386 files green; the local full ui run at `--maxWorkers=3` timed out at 90 min with no failure line — CI shards are the verdict.
- **Overlap:** #37706 landed and was merged in (de-quote-pairing pin 135 → 129); open #37719 (move-only split of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) conflicts textually — whichever lands second merges main. No cloud#5027 PR touches these files.
- **Landing tier:** `check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectstack#37720`: 0 of 223 paths governed; size +1,298 / −32,691 > 3,000 ⇒ human approval and merge (Tier H on size). `mergeable_state` clean.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f5c6af662e4678d31f1acb7f3f1f0e36dd587a5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: none (no reviewFace hits) + ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/{ChatbotEnhanced.tsx,chatMessageAdapter.ts,core.ts,index.tsx,mapMessages.ts,publishHealth.ts,toolResultParsers.ts,useObjectChat.ts}, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/{AiChatPage.tsx,ConversationsSidebar.tsx,outboundAgentText.ts,BuildDebugDrawer.tsx,ExcelImportBar.tsx,PendingDraftsBar.tsx,artifactStudioPath.ts,buildDebugApi.ts,changeCardLabels.ts,mainAreaDraft.ts}, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/{ChatDock.tsx,ChatDockConversation.tsx}, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/{AutomationsPillar.tsx,DataPillar.tsx,StudioAiCopilot.tsx,StudioDesignSurface.tsx,StudioMetadataArea.tsx,StudioPermissionSetPage.tsx,StudioRightSlot.tsx,studioRightSlotState.ts,useSurfaceDeepLink.ts}, ui/packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/scripts/{zh-hant.mjs,zh-hant.d.mts}, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en.ts,zh.ts}, ui/scripts/{check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs,check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs}, .changeset/37682-*.md (② only)
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Read: card #37682 (body and all four comments), PR #37720 (body, 223-file list, net diff against merge-base `0f8e13b0`), and the 58 check-runs on the head (45 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed: Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size). Nothing was built or run; every finding below is read off `git show` of the head and `origin/main`.

`Security-touching: yes` is by the letter of the rule, and it is a removal, not a widening: the diff rewrites the `listImport` grant's doc in `affordanceGrants.ts`, drops a mount from the write census in `plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`, and deletes the `useCanAuthorMetadata` branches in `AiChatPage.tsx` and `ChatDockConversation.tsx`. No principal gains an affordance: the Build Doctor, the spreadsheet import bar and the maker convergence all leave; the approval-confirm path is kept (see ④a).

### ① Derived judgments

Measured by diffing the declarations of base and head, not by the PR body.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` root, functions** — `detectDraftResult`, `detectProposedPlan`, `detectProposedChanges`, `detectBuilderHandoff`, `detectBuiltAppPackage`, `detectAuthoringVerdict`, `detectReplayOutcome`, `buildProgressFromDraftReview` leave `index.tsx`. Right: each read only a build envelope; no head source imports one.
- **Root, types** — `DraftReview`, `ProposedPlan`, `ProposedChanges`, `BuilderHandoff`, `ReplayOutcome`, `PublishOutcome` leave. Right. `mapMessages.ts` also drops 13 further exports (`ProposedPlanCard`, `BuildResultChecklist`, `supersededPlanIds`, `detectBuildChecklist`, `detectPublishedBuildReview` and others); none was re-exported from an entry, so none is published surface.
- **`ChatbotEnhancedProps`** — 133 members at base, 74 at head; the 59 removed are exactly the 59 the changeset lists, none added. `FloatingChatbotProps extends ChatbotEnhancedProps`, so it loses the same set. Right.
- **`ChatbotLabels`** — `designingPlanLabel`, `designingPlanHints` (27 to 25). Right.
- **`ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`** — `draftReview`, `proposedPlan`, `proposedChanges`, `builderHandoff`, `replayOutcome` (18 to 13); `SeamToolInvocation` loses the same through `RuntimeOnlyToolInvocationKeys`, now `pendingActionId` alone. Right.
- **`ChatbotEnhancedMessage`** — `buildProgress`, `blueprintProgress` (15 to 13); `SeamChatMessage` the same. Right.
- **Unlisted but implied** — `ObjectChatMessage` (root export, `Omit` of `SeamChatMessage`) loses the same two message keys and five invocation keys. The changeset names the Seam types and not this one. Nit N1.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`** — `PublishOutcome` only. Right.
- **Kept, correctly** — `publishHealthFromResponse` and `PublishHealth` at both entries (root now re-exports from `./publishHealth` directly); `detectPendingApproval`, `detectRecordHandoff`, `detectRecordWrite`, `detectAnswerSource`, `detectSampleDataCleanup`, `detectPackageRemoval`, `chartsFromParts`, `storedAnswerData`, the `toRuntime*` seam. No ask-path export was removed by mistake.
- **Remains, build-only** — `UseObjectChatOptions.parentConversationId` (the handoff's first-turn context) has no caller left in the tree. It belongs with leftover 1 of the Acceptance notes; removing it is a further narrowing and is rightly not in this PR. `isBuildAgent` stays and is still read (`chatScope.ts`, `surfaceAgent.ts`, `useAgents.ts`).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** — `ConversationsSidebar` loses `includeAskConversations`. Right. The package is `private: true`, so this is workspace surface; `index.ts` is untouched and still exports `AiChatPage`, `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages`, `ConversationsSidebar`, `toUIMessages`. `turnDraftPackage`, `deriveBoundPackageId`, `isThreadBoundToPackage`, `editAppDataSuggestions`, `resolveOutboundAgentText`, `OUTBOUND_GATE_TEXT` were module exports never re-exported from the entry.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`** — 280 distinct keys in the changeset list (209 + 14 + 14 + 6 + 28 = 271 pack keys, 9 Studio namespace keys). The 9 Studio keys match the `studio/en.ts` hunk one for one. No removed key is read by any head source under `ui/packages` or `ui/apps` (full-key search over the 196 base keys, and prefix search for `chatbot.build|changes|plan|phase`, `excelImport`, `engine.studio.copilot`): the only `chatbot.build.*` reads left are `issuesSummary` and `health.seedFailed` in `preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, and both keys are kept. `GATE_ONLY_KEYS` leaves `scripts/zh-hant.mjs`, which is not in the package's `files`, so it is not published surface.

### ② Semver level

- **Level: right.** `Metadata-protocol: none` is true (no `packages/spec` path, nothing a metadata author writes changes), so AGENTS.md step 3 gives `patch` with the BREAKING banner kept. Both changesets are `patch`, carry `!` in the summary, a **BREAKING** banner, one ADR-0087 marker each (`runtime-export-retired`, `no-migration-prescription`), and the first carries the FROM/TO table and the one-line fix. `core`, `plugin-grid` and `plugin-form` at `patch` for comment and test edits: right.
- **M1 (must-fix) — the `Clause-②:` line under-declares on all three carriers.** The PR body and both changesets read bare `Clause-②: no`. The diff retires published exports, 59 props, 9 type members and 280 released keys, and its own changesets call that BREAKING. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` defines the arm for exactly this: "`no (narrowing)` — NOT a widening, but breaking. This is the whole point of the arm", and `references/contract-review.md` fixes the published accept set as what the package `exports` map reaches. House practice agrees: of the `!` changesets recorded in the CHANGELOGs of `plugin-chatbot`, `i18n` and `app-shell`, 58 carry a `(narrowing)` arm and 3 a bare `no`, and every "retire N zero-consumer exports" entry in `components` reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The claim comment on the card says it too ("narrows a public surface"). The fix is the line `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` in the PR body and in both `.changeset/37682-*.md`.
  What the missing arm switched off, each of which the arm exists to switch on:
  1. the `Skills-docs:` third line the PR body then owes (S1 below is what that line would have had to answer);
  2. the full dogfood battery on the final head: the os-dev report records `dogfood_battery` as "n/a — no `!` in the PR title and no (narrowing) arm", while both changesets carry `!`;
  3. the narrowing face itself, so that this review is owed by the tree and not only by the PR's size.
- Nit N2: the PR title is `feat(chatbot): retire the build chat frontend`, without the `!` both changeset summaries carry.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **Deviation, heavy runs outside `os-verify-lock.sh` and a local full run that timed out** — answered by the head's check-runs: Test UI 16/16 shards `success`.
- **Deviation, out-of-surface edits** (the DEBT entry in `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, the `plugin-grid` preload in 17 tests, the importer entry in `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`) — read; each follows a deleted file and none loosens a gate: the DEBT row names a test whose comment-stripping code left with the build keys, and the importer list loses the one file that no longer reads a pack. Accepted.
- **Deviation, size/xl** — the Tier H hand-off stands; not this record's to waive.
- **Leftover 1, builder-handoff plumbing** — confirmed dead and harmless at this head: `useConsoleChatDock` still builds `{ target, onTargetChange, handoff }`, `ChatDockPanel` no longer declares or reads `handoff`, and nothing sets one. Escalated to the seat to file.
- **Leftover 2, plan-approval bus** — confirmed: `publishPlanApprovalPending` is now only called with `pending: false` (`useConversationList.ts`), the store is in-memory, so no marker can stick after an upgrade. `usePlanApprovalPendingCount` has no reader. Escalated to the seat to file.
- **Leftover 3, surfaceAgent maker helpers** — confirmed: no caller passes `canAuthorMetadata`; `makerConvergedOnBuild` and `makerVisibleAgents` are read by tests only. Escalated to the seat to file.
- **Leftover 4, `showDebug` always false** — confirmed. Escalated to the seat to file, with leftover 1.
- **Stale text the PR names** (`check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, `ui/.changeset/12724-plan-card-posture.md`, `usePublishAllDrafts` comments) — confirmed present. `ui/.changeset/` holds no `config.json`; whether that directory is still consumed is the seat's to answer before the plan-card changeset can publish a sentence about a deleted card.
- **Not flagged by the dev, escalated here:**
  - S2 below: a build entry in the console the Acceptance notes do not list.
  - S3 below: the published spec names the deleted code as its consumer.
- **SQL push-down (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5):** not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; it removes client code.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — stated in ②: the declaration reads `Clause-②: no` where the tree is a narrowing. The code at this head holds; the findings on it are should-fix and nits.

S1 (should-fix) — two consumer documents still teach the removed surface, and one ships in the tarball. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` (in the package's `files`) says `ObjectChatMessage` carries `buildProgress`, `blueprintProgress`, `draftReview`, `proposedPlan`, `proposedChanges`, `builderHandoff` (lines 127 to 130 and 312) and documents `onPlanApprovalPendingChange` (line 206). `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` documents the plan and result cards and names `planExtendExistingMessage`, `planBuildNewAppMessage`, `changesConfirmMessage`, `onReviewDrafts`, `onDiscardDrafts`, `fetchPendingDraftCount` (lines 504 to 537) and the same message keys (852 to 855). The card's acceptance asks for no remaining reference under `ui/`; the README is under `ui/`. Fix here, or declare it on the `Skills-docs:` line M1 brings.

S2 (should-fix) — `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx:691` still draws "Edit with AI" on every app with a package and opens `{ agent: 'build', packageId, fresh: true }`, with no `buildServed` gate. At this head the dock drops `packageId` and, where the catalog does not serve `build`, opens the ambient ask thread: a button that promises editing and opens Q&A. It behaved the same on `main` once build closed, so it is not a regression of this diff, but it is a build entry the card's "Do" covers and the Acceptance notes omit. File it with the leftovers, or remove the button.

S3 (should-fix, by a follow-up card, not in this PR) — `packages/spec/src/ai/build-progress.zod.ts` names its consumer as `extractBuildProgress` in `mapMessages.ts` and `ChatBuildProgress` at `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:163`, and `content/docs/references/ai/build-progress.mdx` repeats it. Both are deleted here; no code in this repository reads `BUILD_PROGRESS_FRAME_TYPE` any more. The published schema is now declared with no consumer, which is ADR-0049's enforce-or-remove case. `packages/spec` is governed and outside this card, so it needs its own card under the build-retirement epic.

Per scoped file:

- **(a) ask chat keeps its behaviour.** `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: the 46 removed top-level declarations are all plan, change, build-result, publish-line or handoff code (`QuotaBlockedNextStep` served the change card only); the kept set holds `ModelPicker`, `LivenessIndicator` and `useTurnLiveness`, `AnswerCharts` and `layoutAnswer`, `SmartToolOutput`, `ErrorBanner`, `ToolActivitySummary`. `getToolState` now reads `awaiting` from `approval-requested` alone, and `shouldRenderDetailedTool` still opens on `pendingActionId`, a failure and `recordHandoff`. `renderToolDetail` keeps the decision strip, the record-write card and the payload rules. `mapMessages.ts` still lifts `approval`, `pendingActionId`, `recordHandoff`, `recordWrite`, `answerSource`, `sampleDataCleanup`, `packageRemoval`, charts and record citations. `AiChatPage.tsx` still wires `useHitlInChat` (`onToolApprove`, `toolDecisions`), `models` / `selectedModelId` / `onModelChange`, `onOpenRecord`, the attachment path (`isSpreadsheetAttachment`, `uploadChatAttachments`, `chatAttachmentNotes`, `resolveAttachmentNoteText`; `chatAttachments.ts` is not in the diff). `useChatConversation.ts` keeps the `pendingApprovalToCachedResult` arm and the part-key carrier, so a cached pending approval still restores with its id. Holds.
- **(b) `/ai/build/…`.** `AiAddressRedirect` and `useConsoleChatDock` are untouched. In `ChatDockConversation.tsx` a target naming `build` that the catalog does not serve resolves to the ambient agent and keeps its conversation id; in `AiChatPage.tsx` the `unavailableKnownAgent` branch still rewrites `/ai/build/ID` to `/ai/ask/ID`. `AiChatPage.buildClosedRoutes-36969.test.tsx` pins both and is green. Holds, with one bound to state plainly: the redirect happens where the catalog does not list `build`. Where a catalog still lists it, the address stays on `build` (the same test pins that), the launcher lists it, and its confirm-gate results draw as finished generic steps with no button. The card's premise is that build is closed, so this is accepted, not a finding.
- **(c) deleted symbols and dead keys.** No head source under `ui/packages` or `ui/apps` names a deleted file, detector, prop or type; the remaining hits are CHANGELOGs, the two documents of S1, the spec of S3 and comments (N3). No removed key is read (①).
- **(d) Studio.** `StudioRightSlot` shows when `open && hasProps`, its one body is the properties portal target and stays mounted; `StudioRightSlotHandle` loses `mode` and no reader is left; the title-row toggle is drawn only while a pillar has claimed the slot; `data-studio-slot` follows the same predicate. The state is the one the surface already had on an agent-less deployment, so it is a path that existed and was tested. The width store keeps the `props` key and clears the two retired ones. Holds.
- **(e) `publishHealth`.** `publishHealth.ts` keeps `PublishHealth`, `PublishHealthIssue`, `publishHealthFromResponse`; `core.ts` and `index.tsx` both export the function and the type; `preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:30` imports them from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`. Holds.
- **`ConversationsSidebar.tsx`, `outboundAgentText.ts`, `ChatDock.tsx`** — the sidebar scopes to the active agent's alias group; the outbound module keeps the attachment notes and their conversation-language rule; the dock menu keeps usage, Share and fill. Hold.
- **`affordanceGrants.ts`, `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, `chatMessageAdapter.ts`, `toolResultParsers.ts`, `useObjectChat.ts`, `core.ts`, `useSurfaceDeepLink.ts`, the three pillar files, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx`, `StudioPermissionSetPage.tsx`** — comment edits and the removal of the copilot's chip-label reports; each matches the code beside it. Hold.
- **`zh-hant.mjs`, `zh-hant.d.mts`, `studio/{en,zh}.ts`, the two `ui/scripts` gates** — hold (①, ③).

Nits:

- N1 — name `ObjectChatMessage` beside the Seam types in the changeset's "What leaves" paragraph.
- N2 — PR title without `!` (②).
- N3 — stale comments: `StudioRightSlot.tsx` says `⌘.` "opens and closes" the slot while the handler in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` only opens a hidden one; `hooks/chatScope.ts` still describes `editPackageId`; `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` lines 2584 and 2603 still describe `data-build-progress` frames, and line 491 the pending-drafts bar.
- N4 — `ChatPane` no longer sends `context.autoPublishAiBuilds` on any agent's turn. It described the build posture only; noted so the cloud side does not read its absence as `false` by surprise.

No finding touches the removed files themselves: `BuildDebugDrawer.tsx`, `buildDebugApi.ts`, `ExcelImportBar.tsx`, `PendingDraftsBar.tsx`, `artifactStudioPath.ts`, `changeCardLabels.ts`, `mainAreaDraft.ts` and `StudioAiCopilot.tsx` have no importer at the head.

The FAIL is M1 alone. A head that carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the three carriers, the `Skills-docs:` line (or S1 fixed), and the dogfood battery pinned to it needs a delta review of those lines, not a second reading of the removal.

epic:#5024#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPTfYJJKJmzZ3By7a7

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `18cec5f4028a0d9ae642d677152c59c1bb69c41e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: none (no reviewFace hits) + .changeset/37682-retire-build-chat-frontend.md, .changeset/37682-i18n-retire-build-chat-keys.md, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md, content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Delta review. The first-round record on head `2f5c6af662e4678d31f1acb7f3f1f0e36dd587a5` (comment 7206932534, FAIL on M1) covers the removal itself; this record reads only what changed since: `git diff 2f5c6af6 18cec5f4` (one commit, 4 files, 11 insertions and 64 deletions, no source file), the PR body as it stands, and the check-runs on the new head. Nothing was built or run.

Check-runs on `18cec5f4`: 54 `success`, 12 `skipped`, 1 `cancelled`, 0 failed. The cancelled one is a `Governed Surface Queue Guard` run that ended 01:04:47Z and was superseded by a `success` run of the same check at 01:05:08Z. Test UI (16/16 shards), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset and PR-body guards are all `success`.

`Security-touching: yes` is carried from the first round: the PR is the same removal, and the delta itself touches no permission text.

### ① Derived judgments

The delta changes no export, prop, type member or key. One judgment moves:

- N1: closed. `.changeset/37682-retire-build-chat-frontend.md` now says the seam types "with `ObjectChatMessage` built on them" lose the same fields.

Every other ① judgment of the first round stands unchanged.

### ② Semver level

- **M1: closed.** Both changesets read `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` at the start of a line, exactly once each, and the PR body reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs: updated here` on lines 6 to 8. Levels are unchanged and right: `patch` on every package, `!` and the BREAKING banner kept, one ADR-0087 marker per changeset. `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head.
- Of the three things the missing arm had switched off: the `Skills-docs:` line is present and true (S1 below); the narrowing face is now declared on the tree; **the full dogfood battery on this head is pending**. The PR body records it as running on `18cec5f4` with the reading to go in the card report. This record does not attest it. It is a condition of entering the queue, and the seat checks it pinned to this head, full, with any red fixed or reported.
- N2 (PR title without `!`): open, still a nit. The arm now carries the fact the title does not.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **S2: closed as an escalation.** The PR body's Acceptance notes now name `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx:691`, say it is not this diff's regression, and hand it to the seat to file. The button itself is unchanged, as agreed.
- **S3: carried, not closed by this diff.** The published `packages/spec/src/ai/build-progress.zod.ts` still names the deleted code as its consumer. The brief says it goes to a seat card; the PR body does not name it and no card number is in the inputs read. It stays owed by the seat as a follow-up under the build-retirement epic and does not block this PR.
- The four leftovers and the stale-text list of the Acceptance notes are unchanged; the first round's answers stand.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the delta is prose.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **S1: closed.** `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` no longer name any removed prop, field, detector or type (exact-name search of both files at this head for the 59 props and the removed members and exports: no hit). The README drops the `onPlanApprovalPendingChange` paragraph and the build keys of `ObjectChatMessage` and `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`; the docs page drops the plan, result and change card passages. What replaces them agrees with the code: the message carries `charts` and each tool invocation `pendingActionId`. `Skills-docs: updated here` is therefore true of this diff.
- Narrowing face, against the published spec on `main`: the narrowing takes away UI exports and translation keys, no key or value a metadata author writes. The one spec surface it leaves without a consumer is S3 above.
